exit_criteria.legacy_criterion: SQL: at least 4/5 correct without AI in 30 minutes.
Technical: explain retries, idempotency, webhooks, payment states, OAuth, and reconciliation without major conceptual errors.
Discovery: ask business, system, volume, source-of-truth, failure, security, and success-metric questions before designing.
Incidents: separate impact, known facts, unknowns, mitigation, root cause, and permanent fix; never invent an ETA.
Communication: explain one issue differently to an engineer, VP Engineering, and CFO.
Account strategy: produce three priorities tied to outcomes, metrics, owners, risks, and cadence.

Portfolio judgment: rank five simultaneous customer needs using impact, financial/data/security risk, workaround, deadline, and deterioration risk; delegate work, communicate with every customer, and reprioritize when evidence changes.
Writing: complete a customer incident update and an executive summary in 20 minutes with minimal editing.
Behavioral: ten-story catalog, four polished stories, a two-minute TMAY, and a 45-minute final mock completed on Day 23.
English: complete 45 continuous minutes of TAM interview work without switching to Spanish.
